title: The Elder's Greeting to Gaius and Warning Against Diotrephes
description: The Elder (traditionally understood as John) sends a warm greeting to the beloved Gaius, commends his faithfulness and hospitality toward traveling brothers who have gone out for the sake of the Name, and encourages him to continue supporting them. He warns against Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, refuses to welcome them, speaks evil about them, and expels from the church those who wish to receive the brothers. The letter gives a good testimony about Demetrius and concludes with personal greetings.
